q1.question: What types of proxies does Proxium offer?
q1.answer: We offer four types: residential (85M+ IPs), datacenter (500K+ IPs), mobile (10M+ 4G/5G IPs), and ISP (static residential) proxies across 195+ countries.

q2.question: How fast are the proxies?
q2.answer: Our average response time is under 0.6 seconds for residential proxies and under 0.3 seconds for datacenter proxies. We guarantee 99.9% uptime SLA.

q3.question: Do you support SOCKS5?
q3.answer: Yes. All proxy types support HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 protocols with username/password or IP whitelisting authentication.

q4.question: Can I try before I buy?
q4.answer: Absolutely. We offer a free trial with real residential IPs — no credit card required. Start in under 60 seconds.

q5.question: Are the IPs ethically sourced?
q5.answer: Yes. All residential and mobile IPs come from opt-in networks with full user consent. We comply with GDPR and CCPA.
